title: Onnx2TEE: Automated Graph-Aware Model Partitioning for TEE-based Edge AI Protection
abstract: arXiv:2611.33262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI models are increasingly being deployed at the edge. Since these models often require significant research and development to produce, are often deployed in potentially hostile environments, and downstream systems often rely on accurate data; protecting them from theft or manipulation is worthy of serious consideration. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), which provide hardware-enforced separation of software execution, can protect model weights but impose strict resource constraints, making full-model execution impractical for large neural networks. We present Onnx2TEE, an automated, model-independent pipeline that partitions ONNX models across rich, trusted execution environments for non-sequential feed-forward networks using graph-aware segmentation to preserve computational dependencies while minimizing boundary communication and reducing TEE-induced inference latency. Evaluation on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin using an Arm Trust

translated_title: Onnx2TEE：面向基于TEE的边缘AI保护的自动化图感知模型划分
translated_abstract: AI模型正越来越多地被部署到边缘端。由于这些模型通常需要大量的研发投入才能产出，且往往部署在潜在敌意的环境中，下游系统又常常依赖准确的数据，因此保护它们免遭窃取或篡改值得认真对待。可信执行环境通过硬件强制的软件执行隔离能够保护模型权重，但其严格的资源限制使得大型神经网络的全模型执行变得不切实际。我们提出了Onnx2TEE，这是一个自动化的、与模型无关的流水线，针对非顺序前馈网络，采用图感知分割方法将ONNX模型划分到资源丰富环境与可信执行环境之间，在保持计算依赖关系的同时，最小化边界通信并降低由TEE引入的推理延迟。在搭载Arm Trust...的NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上的评估（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Onnx2TEE，一个自动化的图感知模型划分流水线，能够将ONNX模型智能分割到可信执行环境与资源丰富的环境中，在保护边缘AI模型免遭窃取或篡改的同时，最小化边界通信开销并降低TEE带来的推理延迟。
en_tdlr: Onnx2TEE is an automated, graph-aware pipeline that partitions ONNX models between TEEs and resource-rich environments, protecting edge AI models from theft or manipulation while minimizing boundary communication and TEE-induced inference latency.
